items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: Because she always speaks of Jimmy Newland and the time that they were playing.

ctx.x: I met her once and Lizzie Miles introduced me to her as her teacher or something from backstage of the Mardi Gras about five or six years ago, a long time ago. Yeah. I've never seen her since.
Because she always speaks of Jimmy Newland and the time that they were playing. Really? It looked like she worked with Jimmy for quite some time. You know, now I'm here.
I must try to see a reminder.
